name: Business-logic authorization failure
mental_model: The application authorizes isolated endpoints but fails to enforce who may perform a transition, in what order, and under which business preconditions.
security_property: Every business transition must enforce actor authority, current state, invariants, and one-time constraints on the server.
root_causes: Workflow state trusted from the client
Authorization omitted from an alternate transition path
One-time or sequencing invariant not enforced atomically
signals: A later step is reachable before a required earlier step
An alternate route bypasses the same business check
Replay changes synthetic state more than once

hypothesis_templates.statement: When {actor} requests {transition} from {current_state} without {required_precondition}, {application} may produce {controlled_effect}.
preconditions: The workflow and data are entirely synthetic
The effect is reversible and strictly budgeted
hypothesis_templates.expected_safe_behaviour: The server denies the transition and leaves state unchanged.
hypothesis_templates.expected_vulnerable_behaviour: The transition succeeds despite the missing business precondition.
hypothesis_templates.falsifier: Every alternate path enforces the same precondition atomically.
stop_conditions: The action has financial or third-party effect

safe_test_pattern: Model one synthetic workflow, take before/after state snapshots, attempt one missing-precondition transition, and compare a permitted transition plus fail-closed denial.
positive_controls: A transition with every required precondition succeeds once
negative_controls: The missing-precondition transition is denied with state unchanged
falsifiers: The documented rule permits the transition
Server state remains unchanged across every alternate path

minimum_evidence.description: Before/after synthetic workflow state and exact transition receipt.
Actor, state, precondition, and permitted-transition model.
Permitted-transition positive control and missing-precondition denial control.
Repeat from reset synthetic state with identical transition budget.
Human statement limited to the exact synthetic state invariant violated.

common_false_positives: Client display differs while server state remains correct
A race or cache artifact not reproduced from clean state
impact_boundaries: Unexpected ordering does not itself prove unauthorized impact
Synthetic state change does not prove financial or production effect
minimum_impact_rules: Perform one transition and restore state
Never create financial, inventory, communication, or third-party effects
remediation: Enforce workflow invariants server-side and atomically
Make one-time operations idempotent and replay-resistant
programme_policy_considerations: Confirm business-logic testing methods and rate limits
Avoid financial or resource consumption effects
Seek clarification when the intended rule is ambiguous

revisions.summary: Initial state-transition authorization card and reversible workflow fixture.
